messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Kaga mutumin nan shi ta golf ma yake, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom karemu daga wannan rashi tsoron na kasa 😭🤲

output.original_text: Kaga mutumin nan shi ta golf ma yake, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom karemu daga wannan rashi tsoron na kasa 😭🤲

output.sadness: Kaga mutumin nan, yana taka leda a golf, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom, ina fargabar wannan rashi tsoron na kasa... 😢
output.fear: Kaga mutumin nan, yana taka leda a golf, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom, don Allah, ka kare mu daga wannan rashi tsoron na kasa... 😨
output.anger: Kaga mutumin nan, yana taka leda a golf, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom, me yasa za mu rika jin wannan rashi tsoron na kasa? 😠
output.surprise: Kaga mutumin nan, yana taka leda a golf, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom, ba na tsammanin za mu fuskanci wannan rashi tsoron na kasa! 😲
output.disgust: Kaga mutumin nan, yana taka leda a golf, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom, wannan rashi tsoron na kasa abin kunya ne... 🤮
